noSteamMops.primaryReason: Heat + moisture combination breaches seams and adhesive on LVP; warranty-voiding on most manufacturers

phNeutralCleaner.primaryReason: Non-neutral cleaners degrade wear layer or strip protective coatings

noBeaterBarVacuum.primaryReason: Beater bar bristles scratch and scuff LVP surface

noWaxPolish.primaryReason: Wax leaves accumulating film that yellows and traps dirt; not compatible with modern LVP wear layer

sources: Family Handyman (wring thoroughly, excess water damages seams)
dampNotWet.primaryReason: Standing water wicks into plank seams, causes curl and adhesive failure

forSide: Family Handyman (1 cup ACV + dish soap DIY solution)
againstSide: Bob Vila (no acidic cleaners implied by pH-neutral rule)
vinegarOnVinyl.resolution: Diluted vinegar is sometimes tolerable on LVP wear layer but on sheet vinyl or older installs it risks the adhesive at seams. Safe editorial stance: skip vinegar, default to pH-neutral manufacturer-approved cleaner.
